blocks.text: Jai Opetaia’s eyebrow-raising move to heavyweight to fight Deontay Wilder is over after the Australian withdrew from their bout. The Gold Coast-based Opetaia (31-0) was set to move up from cruiserweight to face former world champion Wilder on the undercard to Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua’s Cardiff blockbuster next month. “Fighter to ​fighter I know the feeling and it’s ​frustrating. I’ve ‌always prided myself of fighting anyone, anyplace,” ​Opetaia posted on social media on Wednesday night. He rubbished suggestions he’d pulled out of the fight because of Wilder’s “big right hand”. “The goal has never changed and still like I’ve always […]...
